limitations: These are supporting input locations, not the missing RCIsuit connectivity or dCCI/impact-ranking outputs.
Current and future are source scenario labels. Feature observation dates and commissioning dates are not established.
Several auxiliary field definitions and the relationships among the three dam-status columns remain unresolved.
One Country value is null. Source spelling, capitalization, status labels and nulls are retained.
The authors report checking barriers against imagery and planning documents; that verification was not repeated in this pilot.
doi_scope: The dataset DOI identifies the original deposited package. This preparation has no separately registered DOI.
temporal_note: Catalog time uses the preserved Shapefile modification time; source scenario labels are not observation dates.
processing: Convert all 562 records from the supplied UTF-8 Shapefile to one GeoPackage layer.
Preserve native WGS84 (EPSG:4326) coordinates, record order, all 31 attributes, nulls, category spelling, current/future labels and per-record source references.
No reprojection, filtering, geometry repair, snapping, status harmonization, connectivity calculation or barrier ranking.
GeoPackage stores numeric values in native SQLite numeric types rather than Shapefile display widths/decimal declarations; decoded values must remain exactly equal.
license_note: The Zenodo record lists Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International for this deposited package. Retain original per-record Source attribution fields.

data.id: Identifier supplied with the barrier record.
data.Barrier_Ca: Source barrier category. Observed values: Dam (359) and waterfall (203).
data.Country: Country label as supplied; one record has no label.
data.POINT_X: Stored x-coordinate attribute; retained without replacing the actual point geometry.
data.POINT_Y: Stored y-coordinate attribute; retained without replacing the actual point geometry.
data.Dam_Stage_: Original source status field; values and capitalization are retained.
data.Dam_Stag_1: Additional source status field; retained separately from Dam_Stage_.
data.Dam_Stag_2: Source status-change/provenance field; observed values include no_change and RAISG_2023. Meaning is not otherwise reconciled.
data.Source: Source reference recorded with the barrier; preserved verbatim.
data.scenario: Source scenario label: current (293) or future (269). The current R workflow filters current; the future workflow uses both groups.
